name: What is a commercial build-out?

acceptedAnswer.text: A commercial build-out, also known as tenant improvement, involves customizing an existing commercial space to suit the specific needs of a new business. This can range from minor cosmetic changes like paint and flooring to significant structural modifications, including new walls, plumbing, electrical systems, and HVAC. The goal is to transform a shell or previously occupied space into a functional and compliant environment ready for business operations, often tailored to the industry and brand aesthetics of the tenant.
acceptedAnswer.description: A commercial build-out customizes an existing commercial space to fit a new business's specific operational and aesthetic needs, from minor cosmetic updates to major structural changes.
